notes.title: Progress Update 07
notes.content: [h3][b]Progress Update: September 11, 2025[/b][/h3][p]Since August, I have been working on multiple fronts simultaneously. [/p][p]I've been in touch with Grenearl's voice actor, Elizaveta, to record the audio for the second time. She is highly professional and easy to communicate with. Initially, both of us were concerned about whether the re-recording would meet expectations, so I provided her with a machine-translated full script of Gren's lines along with recent gameplay videos for reference. Fortunately, the new recordings have turned out much better! The re-recording process is now in full swing. A huge thank you to Elizaveta for her hard work and dedication![/p][p]On the translation and proofreading front, Diana has completed proofreading the character profiles. After discussion, we decided to start with Evgeniya's route. I've provided her with the translated texts for E01 to E24, and the proofreading for these chapters is expected to be completed by the end of September.[/p][p]The publishing rights for Knell of St. Godhrkar have been successfully transferred. Both the Taptap and Steam publishing rights have been returned to me, which will make future updates much more convenient. (Will there actually be updates? Maybe!)[/p][p]Additionally, over the past two weeks, I've finished the coding for J1's scenes. This week, I'll begin working on J2's scenes. The mysterious mini-game I've been planning to add is finally coded and playable! With this progress, I've also fixed long-standing bugs in the main story's finale route, and internal testing is about to begin![/p][p][/p][h3][b]~ Antinomy Worldview Knowledge Corner ~[/b][/h3][p]Q: Hi, I noticed that some default options seem to be randomized. Why is that? During my playthrough, I found that the default choices in G11 varied even when I made the same prior decisions. Could you explain this?[/p][p]A: Ah, you caught that! Generally, if a default option appears randomized, it means the character has no strong preference between the choices—either both options are equally unimportant or both are deeply desired. In G11, whether it's Priscilla or Rihert, both are irreplaceable best friends to Grenearl. When faced with a dilemma, he genuinely wants to help both of them. He really treasures his friends a lot![/p][p](P.S. Every week, we select interesting questions from our readers to answer. If you have any questions about the St. Godhrkar series, feel free to ask. Your question might be featured next time! ✨)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565067/164fbfea4a6f716dc5657204077caf17db05c8e3.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Progress Update 06 |Elegy's Heroine? Unlocking the Secrets of Evgenia's Route!
notes.content: [h3][b]Progress Update: August 28, 2025[/b][/h3][p]August has been a productive month! I’ve been working overtime lately and have made significant progress: Evgenia’s voice acting has been fully implemented. But when I moved on to Grenearl, I noticed some fairly significant issues with the voice recordings… I actually picked up on them during the first recording session, but I was a bit hesitant to request too many revisions at the time (ahhh!). I thought most of it would be usable, but it turns out… it really isn’t. We’re planning to re-record after the voice actor returns from vacation in September. This time, I hope they can refer more closely to the tone and delivery references I provided ORZ.[/p][p]Our editor, Diana, has been as efficient as ever! She already completed the proofreading for locations and concepts by mid-August. Now, I’ve sent her the character profiles for proofreading. Her efficiency is almost too much, that I have to keep up and speed up the translation progress![/p][p]Also, since the publishing contract for "Knell of St. Godhrkar" has expired, the process is almost complete! While reviewing the code for the previous game, I was not only stunned by the sheer complexity but also discovered many untranslated sections in the English version.... I has decided to take some (very limited) time to optimize the code for the Knell. We’re hoping to release a major update soon (though it’ll probably break previous save files…!).[/p][p]Additionally, last week, we completed all the scenes for the first two days of the P route. One particular scene had 8 different variations due to overlapping choices! it was an intense and exhilarating mix of possibilities![/p][p][/p][h3][b]~ Antinomie World Knowledge Corner ~[/b][/h3][p]Q: Hi Birctreel! I recently finished playing the demo of Elegy and felt that this installment is another huge leap forward compared to the Knell. It feels like a major production: the writing, music, and art all show incredible dedication. The storylines for the 3 characters are also very engaging. Personally, I love Evgenia’s route the most; the power struggles among the elites reveal the darkness of human nature driven by benefit in just the right way. However, after finishing E42, I couldn’t shake a faint sense of unease. I really want to know, will Evgenia ultimately reach a bright ending, free from schemes and disguises? She will, right? She definitely will, right? TAT (Please don’t let it be like Shervlett’s route in the Knell… sob sob)[/p][p]A: Wow, thank you so much for your kind words!! I’m really glad you enjoyed Evgenia’s story![/p][p]Evgenia’s route may seem like an otome game (…), but it’s actually the most perilous of the 3 routes. Combined with the character’s own flaws, the early parts may feel a bit frustrating. But don’t worry! Her arrogance stems from courage and decisiveness—and these very traits will guide her toward a (maybe hilariously) happy ending![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565067/6c2a04197fc2d1bd31c0ca5ac0193cbeecc09405.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]
